en.hubeali: Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameel, from Sa’ad Bin Tareyf, from Al Asbagh Bin Nubata who said,
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one for whom is a child, aspires’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ibn Faddal has narrated from abu Jamilah from Sa‘d ibn Tarif from al-Asbagh ibn Nubatah who has said the following: “’
Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘One who has a child, he is in love ardently.’”
